CHAPTER.CAPTION: A Song of Ascents.
CHAPTER.VERS: Those who trust in Jehovah are like Mount Zion, which is not shaken, but remains forever.
As the mountains are around Jerusalem, so Jehovah is around His people from this time forth and forever.
For the scepter of the wicked shall not rest upon the land allotted to the righteous, that the righteous not reach out their hands to iniquity.
Do good, O Jehovah, unto those who are good, and unto those who are upright in their hearts.
As for such as turn aside to their crooked ways, Jehovah shall lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be upon Israel!
